title: Best Laptops for College Students (2026): MacBooks and Beyond | WIRED
text:
The MacBook Air (9/10, WIRED Recommends) is my choice for best overall laptop for everyone. But college students have specific needs—and often, specific budgets. In addition to being affordable, a college student’s laptop should be lightweight and easy to carry around. The MacBook Neo (7/10, WIRED Recommends) fits the bill perfectly. It’s only 2.7 pounds and starts at just $699. It also has a smaller display, which helps it fit on those tiny lecture-hall desks. What makes the MacBook Neo special, however, is its lack of compromise around quality. It’s a gorgeous piece of hardware, with fun colors, an excellent trackpad, a beautiful display, and that Apple “it” factor. I recommend the $699 model, which gets you twice the storage and a Touch ID fingerprint reader.

...

Laptop pricing has skyrocketed over the past few months, which has made it harder to recommend some of the flashier new laptops of the year. Fortunately, many really great laptops from 2025 are still available to buy. The Dell 14 Plus is a great example. It’s one of the few laptops you can get for less than $1,000 that doesn’t force you to make serious compromises. It’s not the world’s prettiest device, but the display is surprisingly sharp, bright, and colorful. The computer’s touchpad and keyboard are both high-quality, and it has tons of ports.

...

The price of the Zenbook A14 varies quite a bit, typically between $600 and $1,000, but there’s often a deal available that makes it an affordable option. There’s also the 2026 model, which comes with the second-gen Snapdragon X2 chip. At $1,600, though, it’s just not worth the extra cash—especially for a college student on a budget.

title: Best Laptops for Developers and AI Work in 2026 (Under £1000 / £1500 / £2500) - Mac user
text:
Forget CPU. For AI you need:

- VRAM: 8GB minimum, 12GB+ ideal for local LLMs. Unified memory on Mac counts differently.
- RAM: 16GB bare minimum, 32GB recommended. 64GB if you run Docker + Chrome + AI.
- NPU: AI Laptop in 2026 means 40+ TOPS NPU for Windows Studio effects + local Copilot.
- Battery under load: Many laptops throttle during training – MacBook Pro M3 Max dominates AI workloads for thermal performance.

### Under £1000 / $900 – The Budget AI Tier

You can get a laptop with an RTX 4060 and 8GB VRAM in this budget. Expect fan noise under load. Expect to offload large training jobs to Google Colab or Kaggle free GPU tier.

My Pick: Lenovo LOQ 2024 / Acer Nitro V

- CPU: i5-13450HX / Ryzen 7 7840HS
- GPU: RTX 4060 8GB VRAM
- RAM: 16GB DDR5 (upgradeable to 32GB)
- Why: Best laptops for Python, TensorFlow & PyTorch under £1000. Perfect for students.
